purpose: Same-subproblem numerical parity check against POT before the fixed-step comparison.
scope: Initial SCOT1047 FP64 full and pair-sampled gradients; epsilon=0.001; unit-mass fixed product reference.
alternative_cost_note: Adds epsilon*log(a*b) to cost; for these uniform marginals this is a scalar shift. Production uses plain GW gradient.
kernel_range_scope: Representative later rounded states; fresh diagnostic pair seeds, not replayed production oracle states.
result: Independent POT first-step plans agree within 1e-11 maximum absolute entry difference; production marginal and normalized-gap tolerance remain 1e-7.
